# Quora (7 endpoints)

## Endpoints

| Resource | Params | Credits | Description |
|----------|--------|---------|-------------|
| /search | `query` | 5 | Search Quora questions |
| /post | `url` | 5 | Get a Quora question |
| /answers | `query` | 5 | Search Quora answers |
| /posts | `query` | 5 | Search Quora space posts |
| /profiles | `query` | 5 | Search Quora profiles |
| /spaces | `query` | 5 | Search Quora Spaces |
| /topics | `query` | 5 | Search Quora topics |

### Parameter legend

- `a`, `b` — both required.
- `a` / `b` — a `oneOf` group: at least one member must be provided.
- `a`? — the spec marks nothing required, but these are the parameters the endpoint accepts;
  a bare call usually will not work. See Endpoint Details for which combination to send.
- *(none)* — takes no parameters at all.
- A method prefix (**POST**, **DELETE**, **PATCH**) marks a non-GET endpoint; unmarked rows are GET.
- Every endpoint also accepts the `Cache-Control` header (send `no-cache` to bypass the
  response cache — billed at the normal rate) and `Idempotency-Key` (a UUID that makes a
  retry safe; a replay returns the cached payload without double-billing).

## Endpoint Details

_What each endpoint returns and when to reach for it._

### /search — 5cr

Returns Quora questions matching a keyword: title, URL, answer count, follower count, and publish time. Filter by recency with time. For written answers to a topic call GET /v1/quora/answers with the same query.

**Parameters**

- `query`: Search keywords, for example learn programming.
- `time` *(optional)*: Recency window: all, hour, day, week, month, or year. Default all.
- `limit` *(optional)*: Maximum rows to return, 1 to 10. Default 10.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/quora/search?query=<query>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /post — 5cr

Returns one Quora question from its URL: title, body text, and published date. Quora questions rarely have a separate body; content.text is the title. For written answers call GET /v1/quora/answers with a keyword.

**Parameters**

- `url`: Full URL of the Quora question, for example https://www.quora.com/What-is-the-best-alternative-to-SendGrid-Email-API.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/quora/post?url=<url>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /answers — 5cr

Returns Quora answers matching a keyword, including the answer text, author name and credential, upvotes, views, and the parent question title.

**Parameters**

- `query`: Search keywords, for example learn programming.
- `time` *(optional)*: Recency window: all, hour, day, week, month, or year. Default all.
- `limit` *(optional)*: Maximum rows to return, 1 to 10. Default 10.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/quora/answers?query=<query>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /posts — 5cr

Returns posts from Quora Spaces matching a keyword: URL, author, upvotes, comments, and publish time. Post body text is often absent from this search surface.

**Parameters**

- `query`: Search keywords.
- `time` *(optional)*: Recency window: all, hour, day, week, month, or year. Default all.
- `limit` *(optional)*: Maximum rows to return, 1 to 10. Default 10.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/quora/posts?query=<query>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /profiles — 5cr

Returns Quora profiles matching a keyword: display name, profile URL, credential, follower count, and avatar.

**Parameters**

- `query`: Search keywords, for example a topic or a person's name.
- `time` *(optional)*: Recency window: all, hour, day, week, month, or year. Default all.
- `limit` *(optional)*: Maximum rows to return, 1 to 10. Default 10.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/quora/profiles?query=<query>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /spaces — 5cr

Returns Quora Spaces matching a keyword: name, URL, description, member count, and icon. Row shape follows the space search record.

**Parameters**

- `query`: Search keywords.
- `time` *(optional)*: Recency window: all, hour, day, week, month, or year. Default all.
- `limit` *(optional)*: Maximum rows to return, 1 to 10. Default 10.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/quora/spaces?query=<query>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /topics — 5cr

Returns Quora topics matching a keyword: name, URL, follower count, and topic photo.

**Parameters**

- `query`: Search keywords.
- `time` *(optional)*: Recency window: all, hour, day, week, month, or year. Default all.
- `limit` *(optional)*: Maximum rows to return, 1 to 10. Default 10.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/quora/topics?query=<query>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
